description.value: Mansion Nightclub is a South Beach-inspired ultra-premium nightclub spanning over 9,000 square feet in downtown Vancouver, operated by After Dark Hospitality Group alongside several other top-tier venues. The space features soaring ceilings, state-of-the-art sound, and vibrant lighting, and is known for celebrity after-parties, live entertainment, and big-name performances on weekend nights. A touring cyclist finishing a ride in the city could drop in here for an evening of high-energy nightlife in the heart of Vancouver.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 94m. Total: 2 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and confirms the business is an operating nightclub at 1161 West Georgia Street, Vancouver — matching the OSM address exactly. The site provides a phone number (+1 604-671-2550) absent from OSM tags, and the 2026 copyright plus active upcoming events listings confirm the venue is open. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, Wi-Fi, etc.) are mentioned anywhere on the site, so all those fields are null.
concerns: Phone number +1 604-671-2550 is confirmed on the website but was absent from OSM tags — OSM record should be updated to include it.
OSM tags the venue as amenity=bar but it operates primarily as a nightclub with a separate amenity=nightclub tag being more accurate.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Mansion Nightclub is a real, operating, publicly accessible bar/nightclub in downtown Vancouver with an active website and upcoming events. A legitimate stop for touring cyclists seeking evening entertainment.
